initiatives.name: InnovaMatrix Platform Restructuring
initiatives.summary: ConvaTec recorded a non-cash impairment of $72 million for its InnovaMatrix platform following an 80% price reduction by CMS. The company is repositioning the product and reorganizing its sales team to adapt to new market conditions.

evidence.title: InnovaMatrix Platform Impairment Due to Reimbursement
evidence.summary: ConvaTec recorded a non-cash impairment of $72 million for its InnovaMatrix platform following an 80% price reduction by CMS. The company is repositioning the product and reorganizing its sales team to adapt to new market conditions.
evidence.quote: As a result of the estimated impact on future forecasts, we have recorded a non-cash accounting impairment of $72 million for our InnovaMatrix platform, equating to about 20% of the acquisition consideration.

evidence.title: InnovaMatrix Sales Force Reorganization
evidence.summary: ConvaTec completed a reorganization of its InnovaMatrix sales force to resize it appropriately for target markets following CMS price reductions. The reorganized team now covers the whole US with broader geographic scope.
evidence.quote: We have finished the reorganisation of the sales force. That was an unfortunate necessity. We have always said there was a very high level of variable cost in this sector of the market, in particular, some of the commercial execution was very expensive. We have resized that to be appropriate to the target markets going forward.

initiatives.name: M&A Investment Program
initiatives.summary: ConvaTec has invested over $500 million in acquisitions over a multi-year period, focusing on disciplined bolt-on investments. The company plans to continue M&A as a priority area for growth acceleration.

evidence.title: Historical M&A Investment Program Continues
evidence.summary: ConvaTec has invested over $500 million in acquisitions over a multi-year period, focusing on disciplined bolt-on investments. The company plans to continue M&A as a priority area for growth acceleration.
evidence.quote: On M&A, we have invested over $500 million over the period. Last year was a bit smaller. We will continue to be disciplined in acquiring only bolt-on investments, which increase our competitive strength in our focus areas. But this remains a priority area for us, and you should expect to see more investment here to increase growth going forward.

initiatives.name: CFO Appointment - Fiona Ryder
initiatives.summary: Fiona Ryder was appointed as CFO approximately six months prior to the report date. She had been with ConvaTec for four years, working closely with the CEO and previous leadership on strategy delivery.

evidence.title: CFO Appointment - Fiona Ryder
evidence.summary: Fiona Ryder was appointed as CFO approximately six months prior to the report date. She had been with ConvaTec for four years, working closely with the CEO and previous leadership on strategy delivery.
evidence.quote: While I have met many of you here today, for those who I have not, I am Fiona Ryder. I have been the CFO for about six months, and I have been at Convatec for about four years, working closely with Karim and Jonny on the delivery of our strategy.

initiatives.name: Growth CAPEX Investment Program
initiatives.summary: ConvaTec significantly increased growth capital expenditure investments to meet strong demand and support product pipeline expansion. This represents a major step-up in investment to drive organic growth opportunities.

evidence.title: Growth CAPEX Investment More Than Doubled
evidence.summary: ConvaTec significantly increased growth capital expenditure investments to meet strong demand and support product pipeline expansion. This represents a major step-up in investment to drive organic growth opportunities.
evidence.quote: Growth CAPEX of $121 million, more than doubled year-on-year, as we identified compelling organic investment opportunities at high returns, given strong demand for our products and our exciting product pipeline.

initiatives.name: Infusion Care Capacity Expansion
initiatives.summary: ConvaTec is investing significantly in additional capacity for Infusion Care, specifically in Inset Guard for diabetes and Neria Guard for other therapies including Parkinson's disease. This investment supports accelerated growth from 2027.

evidence.title: Significant Infusion Care Capacity Investment
evidence.summary: ConvaTec is investing significantly in additional capacity for Infusion Care, specifically in Inset Guard for diabetes and Neria Guard for other therapies including Parkinson's disease. This investment supports accelerated growth from 2027.
evidence.quote: Then from 2027, we will be accelerating growth in Infusion Care. We will be investing significantly in more capacity, and that will be in Inset Guard to service the diabetes sector, and in Neria Guard for the other therapies, principally Parkinson's.

initiatives.name: Revenue Growth Target Acceleration to 6-8%
initiatives.summary: ConvaTec is increasing its target organic growth rate from previous levels to 6-8% per annum starting from 2027. This acceleration is supported by a rich pipeline of new product launches and higher investment in pipeline and capacity.

evidence.title: Revenue Growth Target Acceleration to 6-8%
evidence.summary: ConvaTec is increasing its target organic growth rate from previous levels to 6-8% per annum starting from 2027. This acceleration is supported by a rich pipeline of new product launches and higher investment in pipeline and capacity.
evidence.quote: With the rich pipeline of new product launches we have got underway and coming, supported by higher investment to grow the pipeline and capacity, we are increasing our target growth rate to 6% to 8% per annum from 2027.
